cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; the national data centre (MWI-005) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the Government Data Centre in Lilongwe was built to consolidate government systems (MWI-002, 2024), so stage 2. It now hosts ministries' systems (MWI-005, June 2026), but no rule on state data is in force in the window, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4; the 2022 UNECA note on health data (MWI-003) is outside it.
